caption:
Hybi's weekly recap for Dec 28 to Jan 2.

Setting a movement goal for the new year? Decide what, when and how much, and plan a 10-minute version for busy weeks. If a cramp hits mid-exercise, stop and pull your toes towards you; most ease in 1–2 minutes. Heading to the snow? Squats and split squats can help prepare your knees. And after a massage, an easy walk is often a nice way to keep moving.

Scroll back through the feed for the full comics. Book online via the link in bio 🐰
